afterFileEdit.prompt: You just edited a Potta web file. If this is a page, form, list, sheet, or invoice/document preview, silently apply these standards on the next edit without asking the user: (1) ListToolbar keeps search and actions on one row; (2) form selects use shadcn Select; (3) sheets/slideovers open from the right; (4) inputs use bg-field / FIELD_* light grey, never white-on-white; (5) no duplicate PageHeader title/description when navbar already titles the page; (6) tables/layout use Skeleton not spinners; (7) API via TanStack custom hooks; (8) invoice seller branding from useOrganizationProfile / Auth org, never hardcoded Instanvi. Only mention a reminder if the edit clearly violates one of these.
